articles.headline: Winless Philadelphia Flyers add depth in Michael Bunting
articles.description: The winless Philadelphia Flyers added to their forward group Tuesday, signing veteran winger Michael Bunting, 30, in the hopes that he can give them a spark following some alarming early season struggles, including scoring just five goals in four games.

articles.headline: Alex Ovechkin's retirement news sparks notable ticket price hike
articles.description: Ever since the NHL's all-time goals leader announced his retirement, ticket prices to Capitals games have been soaring -- and not just for home games.

articles.headline: Scoreless Leafs rookie McKenna on slow start: 'Still believe in myself'
articles.description: Maple Leafs rookie Gavin McKenna is experiencing first-hand the pressure of being a first overall pick -- one who still hasn't scored an NHL point.

articles.headline: Avalanche's Logan O'Connor, Zachary L'Heureux may return on trip
articles.description: Banged-up Colorado forwards Logan O'Connor and Zachary L'Heureux could make their season debuts this week during a two-game road swing.

articles.headline: Stanley Cup odds: Florida Panthers, Carolina Hurricanes lead favorites
